annotations.title: Get price history for an extension

description: Return how each covered registrar's renewal or registration price for one extension changed over time: price periods with the date each price was first seen, when the previous price was last seen, and whether it came from our scheduled refreshes or the registrar's own price page archived by the Internet Archive. A first record may be older than its date. Availability is not checked.

format.description: Response representation. CSV and Markdown use the same filters, order and bounded pagination; they contain main offers, not favorite comparison arrays. MCP retains structured JSON alongside rendered text.

price.description: Which price history to return: the annual renewal (default) or the first-year registration, which includes promotions.

registrar.description: Connected registrar ID from the registrars endpoint. Omit to compare all.

tld.description: One covered ASCII top-level extension, such as com or .com. Multi-part suffixes and IDNs are not covered.

name: get_price_history

Comparison.description: Revisit current standard prices with supported website filters. Omits proposed names and API pagination; does not save prices or availability.

omittedParameters.description: Estimate horizons outside 2, 3, 5 and 10 years use the website default. Favorites are browser-local preferences and are never written by a link. The website never shows stale offers, so includeStale=true is omitted. Disclose omitted settings.

approximate.description: Converted to USD from another currency.

changedAfter.description: The previous price was last seen then: the change happened between this and from.

firstRecord.description: No earlier record; the price may be older than from.

from.description: When this price was first seen.

lastConfirmed.description: Archived prices: the last archived copy still showing this price.

regularCents.description: Published regular price while this price is a promotion.

source.description: refresh: our scheduled refresh (since 2026-09-28). archive: the registrar’s own price page as copied by the Internet Archive.

to.description: When the next price or a removal was first seen; null while current.

current.description: The current step, with the same fields as steps[]; null when the registrar does not list the extension now.

fetchedAt.description: When the current saved offer was retrieved.

pricingBasis.description: The current saved offer’s sample label, as on price offers; absent for published price lists. Preserve it when quoting the current price.

stale.description: True when the source’s last refresh failed and its saved catalog is at least 24 hours old. Passing nextRefreshAt alone does not make prices stale; a scheduled refresh every 15 minutes replaces due catalogs.

truncated.description: True when only the newest periods fit one response.

ServiceInformation.description: Cheapest Domains identity and optional setup links, separate from upstream evidence. Does not establish client installation or provider health.

nextRefreshAt.description: When the saved catalog is due for its next scheduled refresh; not an expiry of its prices.

refresh.description: Progress of a staged catalog refresh, when one exists. Saved prices remain usable meanwhile.

stale.description: True when the source’s last refresh failed and its saved catalog is at least 24 hours old. Passing nextRefreshAt alone does not make prices stale; a scheduled refresh every 15 minutes replaces due catalogs.

outputSchema.description: Successful results are PriceHistory, the REST 200 response; results with isError: true are Error.

title: Get price history for an extension
